| description = A mid-level monster found wandering various zones. Aggressive. <br>
The cyclops in [[Ocean of Tears]] which is a placeholder for [[an ancient cyclops]] might be higher level, requiring 5 [[Ice Comet]]s to take down (Roughly 4600 HP). <br>
The cyclops in [[Southern Karana]] spawns at -6500 +1700 and paths one of two directions: north, towards Splitpaw, or East, towards the Hermit. Has been spotted as far north as the ridge just south of the bridge leading to North Karana. The one that travels east seems to be higher level, giving experience to level 50 Ranger, even though he conned green, without "... its not certain though." in the consider message. This cyclops also shares a spawn with [[Gnashmaw]] and [[Mroon]].
